description: N5/C2 exact-diff review: does the qualification actually prove the claims

tests_prove_claims.instructions: This suite genuinely proves the required C2 behaviours (human and agent projection, revoked-agent history, duplicate suppression, cross-tenant refusal, cross-branch enforcement, payload and credential refusal, append-only history, provenance, correlation retention, unsupported actor refusal, unknown source refusal, no source mutation) rather than asserting only surface shape

criteria.true: Each required behaviour is exercised with a positive case and, where relevant, a negative case that would fail if the control were removed
criteria.false: One or more required behaviours are claimed but not actually exercised

no_overclaim.instructions: The suite avoids implying production readiness, real-provider validation, clinical authority or a cryptographic guarantee

criteria.true: All qualification is explicitly synthetic and local, and the suite asserts no production or clinical property
criteria.false: The suite or its naming implies validation that synthetic tests cannot establish

missing_assertion.instructions: Which single gap in this suite would a careful reviewer flag as the most material missing assertion?

criteria.restricted_surface: That a restricted record can never be reached through the operations read path, including by direct id
criteria.employee_uniqueness: That deduplication holds under genuinely concurrent or interleaved delivery rather than sequential replay only
criteria.provenance_immutability: That a superseding correction cannot retroactively change the provenance or source identity of the record it supersedes
criteria.identifier_leak_via_payload: That a closed-vocabulary payload value cannot itself encode a subject through a caller-controlled code
criteria.other: None of the above; the material gap lies elsewhere
